lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Place household stones beside the covenant witness.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Will courage remain rooted in instruction rather than conquest for its own sake? — Choose This Day is the next step in that question.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: The story does not turn on a hero's strength. It turns on the choice made in the ordinary moment.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The chapter settles. The player has walked the path and seen the outcome. What remains is a reflection, not a rewrite.

choices.label: Walk on with the lesson 📖
choices.note: The story keeps its shape and the player carries the reflection forward.

choices.label: Rest here a moment 🕊️
choices.note: A pause does not change the outcome. It only lets the player breathe.
